credits.title: Miracle
credits.overview: Jangwon is declared bankrupt after he is made a victim of fraud by friend Minkyo. While desperately searching for Minkyo who has disappeared, Jangwon hears that another old school friend, Jiyeon, is also looking for him. Jangwon approaches her as he thinks it would make the search for Minkyo easier.

credits.title: The Emperor
credits.overview: Early one morning in Gangnam, three grim-faced individuals get into a black van. They will face their final moments in life in a secluded countryside motel. In the hushed silence of the motel room, the three are set to spend their farewell night, telling his or her life story to the others.

credits.title: Midnight Runners
credits.overview: Two apathetic police academy recruits who become best buddies through the tough training together witness a woman being abducted right before their very eyes. credits.title: Kissing Cousin
credits.overview: A love for a cousin, deeply engraved in childhood. Twelve years later, a stopped heart begins to beat again.

credits.title: Coin Locker Girl
credits.overview: Il-young tries to get away from her adoptive mother because she does not want to get involved in her mother's criminal activities.

credits.title: The Wish
credits.overview: When young, we might try witchcraft out of curiosity to make our wishes come true, even if it’s scary. For such curiosity, Joohee, who is unable to find hope in reality, pays the price, as well as her friends who she neglects.

credits.title: The Taste of Salvia
credits.overview: Unaware that it is a holiday, Gi-rim arrives at school only to find herself alone in an empty classroom with her classmate, An-na. Though the two girls are not particularly close, the initial awkwardness soon fades. As they spend this unexpected, private time together, their day unfolds into something truly special.
